description: s441 fix round (review:S441-f4f5-review). Since s441 a handler that calls a server function awaits it and runs as an async function. `event.preventDefault()` placed AFTER that call now runs after the handler has yielded — the browser has already submitted the form (reviewer-executed: defaultPrevented false; true before s441). The compiler refuses it rather than silently letting the form submit, and does not move the call (a conditional preventDefault would change meaning).
rationale: §13.2: preventDefault / stopPropagation / stopImmediatePropagation on the handler's event parameter after its first await SHALL be a compile error (E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT, §34).
